newsitem.title: HONG KONG: MIT surges on sharp interim profit rise.
newsitem.headline: MIT surges on sharp interim profit rise.

text.p: Shares Management Investment & Technology (Holdings) Ltd jumped in thin trade on Thursday afternoon after it posted a sharp rise in interim profit.
"It was a short term speculative demand in response to its profit surge, but topside is seen limited due to its unexciting fundamentals," said a sale manager at a local brokerage.
The smoke detector maker's shares rose HK$0.09 or 15.25 percent to HK$0.68 in early afternoon trade on thin volume.
The company posted an interim profit of HK$23.82 million, including an exceptional gain of HK$20.89 million, compared with HK$5.31 million a year ago. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
